seasons.plot: Anne Boonchuy, a self-centered 13-year-old 7th grader, is magically transported to the fictitious world of Amphibia, a rural marshland full of frog-people, also known as Amphibians and dangerous creatures. With the help of an excitable young frog named Sprig Plantar, Anne will transform into a hero and discover the first true friendship of her life.

episodes.name: Anne il mostro / Amici per la pelle
episodes.plot: Sprig cerca di abbattere un misterioso animale da solo per dimostrare di essere il responsabile. Sprig porta Anne a nuotare in un lago vicino per farla sentire meno nostalgica.

episodes.name: Il bastone di Hop Pop / Lacrime, sudore e inondazioni

seasons.plot: Anne and the Plantars are heading out on a quest to unlock the mysteries of the Calamity Box as they leave the cozy confines of Wartwood for the distant city of Newtopia. On their journey, they will visit exotic new locations, uncover hidden secrets, and experience unexpected reunions as they continue to search for a way to get Anne home.

overview.value: Le avventure della tredicenne Anne Boonchuy egocentrica che viene magicamente trasportata nel mondo fittizio di Amphibia, una palude rurale piena di rane. translations.title: Anfibia
translations.overview: Le avventure della tredicenne Anne Boonchuy egocentrica che viene magicamente trasportata nel mondo fittizio di Amphibia, una palude rurale piena di rane.  Con l'aiuto di una giovane rana eccitabile di nome Sprig, Anne si trasformerà in un eroe e scoprirà la prima vera amicizia della sua vita.

The adventures of 13-year-old, self-centered Anne Boonchuy who is magically transported to the fictitious world of Amphibia, a rural marshland full of frog-people. With the help of an excitable young frog named Sprig, Anne will become a hero and discover the first true friendship of her life.
translations.tagline: Life’s never boring when you’re amphibious.
